Work

SMIT Academic Management System

A role-based portal for Sikkim Manipal Institute of Technology. Students, faculty and administrators each get their own dashboard, navigation and permissions, covering attendance, assignments, exams, results, fees, notices and feedback.

Role
Designed and shipped, AI-assisted
Year
2026
Stack
React 19, Vite, Tailwind, Express, MongoDB
Source
GitHub repository

  • Challenge

    Students, faculty and administrators need different views of the same academic records, and none of them should see more than their role allows.

  • Approach

    Access is enforced on the server, not just hidden in the interface: the JWT carries the role, students can only read their own records, and every faculty write is checked against course assignment.

  • Outcome

    A portal for three roles that runs on sample data with no backend, deploys to Vercel, and is backed by server, responsive and accessibility test suites.

Three roles, one system

  • StudentSees only their own attendance, marks, fees and submissions. The server blocks reading another student's records by editing the URL.
  • FacultyMarks attendance and grades only for assigned courses. Every write is checked against course assignment.
  • AdminPublishes results and runs the institute, from departments and reports to fee analytics and access control.

Tested, not just built

  • 6363

    Server-side checks

    Role gating, own-record scoping, schema contracts and route authorisation. Runs without a database.

  • 9696

    Responsive checks

    No horizontal scroll at six widths from 320 to 1440px, and 44px touch targets on phones.

  • 2626

    Accessibility audits

    axe-core across every route for all three roles, the sign-in screen and the mobile drawer.

  • 00

    WCAG 2.1 AA violations

    Text colours are picked to clear 4.5:1 on every surface they land on.

A phone layout, not a shrunken desktop

Bottom navigation with five items and a slide-up drawer for the rest. Tables become stacked cards, and the weekly timetable becomes a day-by-day list.

How it evolved

  • Version 1, React 18

    eCampus ELO Portal

    First build. Recharts and an Express API on MongoDB with JWT role-based auth, running in demo or production mode.

     Repository
  • Version 2, React 19

    SMIT Academic Management System

    Rebuilt with a sample-data mode, the test suites above and a Vercel deployment.

     Repository
